metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Lower Back Pain from Sleeping Wrong
metadataRaw.description:
Did you wake up lower back pain from sleeping badly, maybe in the wrong position?

Dr. Rowe shows how to fix lower back pain from sleeping wrong with very easy, at home exercises. 

These exercises are geared towards fixing muscle tightness, aches, and stiffness quickly... even within 30 SECONDS!

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done in bed and require no equipment. They're also great as daily mobility exercises to maintain the lower back, and help prevent future pain and strain.

Watch now and fix your lower back pain after sleeping wrong!

0:00 Intro
0:38 Dr. Rowe's All-In-One Morning Back Exercise
4:10 Cobra Scorpion
